name: mirage
description: An x86 PC in plain JavaScript: an x86-to-JavaScript dynamic recompiler with a built-in DOS, and a bare PC that boots unmodified operating systems.

scripts.demos: nasm -f bin demos/xormunch.asm -o demos/XORMUNCH.COM && nasm -f bin demos/plasma13.asm -o demos/PLASMA13.COM && nasm -f bin demos/bootload.asm -o demos/BOOTLOAD.IMG && nasm -f bin demos/vesa.asm -o demos/VESA.COM
scripts.test:all: node tools/test.js && node tools/test-x86-uc.mjs && node tools/test-dos.js && node tools/test-gfx.js && node tools/test-demos.js && node tools/golden.js check
